original_question: Are there any dynamical properties of W that are persistent under homotopies of the Engel structure?
target_in_paper: Section 2.5, Question 2.14 (Engel structures): "Are there any dynamical properties of W that are persistent under homotopies of the Engel structure?" ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft is extremely close to the paper: it is essentially verbatim Question 2.14 and correctly focuses on the dynamics of W and persistence under homotopies of the Engel structure. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
missing_details: W should be defined explicitly as the unique kernel or characteristic line field W ⊂ D associated to the Engel structure, characterized by [W,E] = E. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

The Engel structure itself should be named: D ⊂ TM is a rank-2 distribution on a smooth 4-manifold M, and E := [D,D] is the associated even-contact hyperplane field. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

The homotopy should be understood as a homotopy through Engel structures on a fixed 4-manifold M, not an arbitrary homotopy of plane fields. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

The paper intentionally leaves the class of 'dynamical properties' unspecified and even calls this "a vague question," so a faithful stand-alone rewrite should not add extra choices such as entropy, periodic orbits, or conjugacy type. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))

No additional assumptions such as compactness/closedness, orientation, or genericity are stated for Question 2.14, so they should not be inserted. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
refined_question: Let M be a smooth 4-manifold and let {D_t}_{t∈[0,1]} be a homotopy through Engel structures on M. For each t, write E_t := [D_t,D_t] and let W_t ⊂ D_t denote the unique kernel/characteristic line field characterized by [W_t,E_t] = E_t. Are there any dynamical properties of W_t that persist under such homotopies of the Engel structure? ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
justification: The draft is already targeting the correct item: it matches Question 2.14 in Section 2.5 almost word for word. The nearby context supplies exactly the hidden notation needed to make the question stand alone: an Engel structure is a rank-2 distribution D ⊂ TM on a 4-manifold M, E = [D,D] is the induced hyperplane field, and W is the unique kernel/characteristic line field with [W,E] = E. The same paragraph explains the motivation for the question: Engel structures do not satisfy a stability principle under perturbation, so the paper asks whether any dynamics of W survive homotopy anyway. Because the paper does not provide a sharper equivalent reformulation, the faithful refinement is simply to make those ambient definitions explicit and otherwise keep the wording narrow. ([conferences.cirm-math.fr](https://conferences.cirm-math.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Problem_list_3082.pdf))
